ravi: FYI support tickets: customers see "validation error" billed when tools return slightly wrong shape (array vs object).

anna: example?

ravi: payload: `[ {"id": 1 } ]` expected `{id: int}`. Validator marks as validation_failure and we increment invoke.quota_rejects today.

cho: we merged soft and hard for billing simplicity. that was convenient but confusing.

anna: propose: split metrics invoke.validator.hard_rejects and invoke.validator.soft_warnings. bill only hard_rejects. soft shows yellow in console and not billed.

ravi: agree. telemetry: add tag validator.reason (top_level_array, missing_field, wrong_type, parse_error) and include route_name + model_version. sample 100% hard, 1% soft.

cho: routing note: ensure soft stays on same fallback route; don't change degen routing. only billing/telemetry changes.

anna: UX: console Errors -> two tabs Errors (red) / Warnings (amber). Warnings have "create exception" CTA to whitelist a tool shape.

billing-bot: ALERT: any billing mapping change requires finance sign-off.

ravi: action items:
- ravi: metrics PR (validator.reason + split counters)
- anna: console mock + per-account toggle fncall-validator-billing-mode
- cho: implement sampling + keep routing unchanged
- billing-bot: add finance contact for sign-off

cho: short-term: turn on feature flag fncall.soft_billing_exempt for internal orgs only to validate impact.

anna: will prototype UI this week. cho/Ravi can start backend.

billing-bot: CREATED ISSUE BILL-4712 and scheduled canary job for 2026-04-10.

ravi: thanks, will open PR and tag folks.

anna: thanks team.
